en-US.releaseNotes:
Users are encouraged to upgrade for the best experience.

The community keeps growing, and we'd love to see you there!
- Join the discussion in Kubernetes Slack:
  - for questions and just to hang out
  - for discussing PRs, code, and bugs
- Hang out at the Public Developer Call: Thursday, 9:30 Pacific via Zoom
- Test, debug, and contribute charts: ArtifactHub/packages

Notable Changes
- docs(cmd): correct list --max and HELM_COLOR help text #32807 by @ZainnQureshii
- fix(registry): always return a transport Helm can configure #32684 by @ump45nose

What's Next
- 4.3.2 is the next patch releases scheduled for November 11, 2026
- 4.4.0 is the next minor release scheduled for January 13, 2027. There will be no further Helm 3 minor releases (see https://helm.sh/blog/helm-v3-end-of-life)

Changelog
- fix(deps): bump golang.org/x/net to v0.62.0 (#32876) 8346aaa (Sean Schneeweiss)
- chore(deps): bump github.com/distribution/distribution/v3 (#32698) 8c92fca (dependabot[bot])
- fix(deps): bump github.com/klauspost/compress to v1.20.3 (#32878) 214f6f6 (Sean Schneeweiss)
- chore(deps): bump the k8s-io group across 1 directory with 7 updates 90d48fc (dependabot[bot])
- fix(registry): always return a transport Helm can configure (#32684) 961bddf (ump45nose)
- docs(cmd): correct list --max and HELM_COLOR help text (#32807) ddb8be7 (Zain Qureshi)
